hunts.kql:
// TH-2026-0003 Scheduled tasks launching encoded PowerShell
// Platform: Microsoft Defender XDR
// For Microsoft Sentinel, replace Timestamp with TimeGenerated.
// MITRE ATT&CK: T1053.005, T1059.001
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp >= ago(7d)
| where ActionType == "ProcessCreated"
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "taskeng.exe"
    or (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "svchost.exe"
        and InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(^|[ \t])-s[ \t]+schedule($|[ \t])")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(^|[ \t])-(encodedcommand|enc|e)[ \t]+"
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, ReportId, AccountDomain, AccountName,
    FileName, FolderPath, ProcessId, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName,
    InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
hunts.summary: eSentire observed Vinci RAT persist through a scheduled task that ran obfuscated PowerShell. The hunt looks for a related behavior: Windows Task Scheduler directly launching PowerShell with an encoded-command switch. A match is a lead for investigating the task and its origin. The query covers a subset of scheduled PowerShell activity and has no campaign-specific indicators.
hunts.title: Scheduled tasks launching encoded PowerShell

hunts.summary: Drupal core before 10.6.22, 11.3.22 and 11.4.13 lets an anonymous attacker use install.php to try to reinstall a live site, leading to takeover or code execution (CVE-2026-132165). Exploitation was reported from 19 November 2026 and CISA added it to KEV on 24 November. With no published indicators, this hunt looks on Linux web servers for settings.php written by PHP, PHP files under sites/*/files, and shells spawned by PHP workers on those hosts.
hunts.title: Drupal installer abuse on Linux web servers

hunts.summary: Exploited web apps (Exchange, SharePoint, file transfer and VPN portals) usually end with a web shell that runs commands as the web server's worker process. This hunt finds IIS, Apache, nginx, Tomcat and PHP workers launching command shells, PowerShell, or common discovery and download tools.
hunts.title: Web server worker processes spawning shells and recon tools
